title: S7 ISO 19650 exchange sequence and declaration conformance
test_intent: Determine whether an ISO 19650-governed information-model exchange preserves the applicable approval-for-sharing, authorization and acceptance sequence, project role mapping, exchange declaration and CDE transition evidence without substituting TIVERIT supplementary or platform actions.

applicability.applies_when: ISO 19650 is applicable to the tested project exchange and the event claims a governed Shared or Published transition or information-model delivery.
applicability.not_applicable_when: ISO 19650 is not applicable to the tested exchange or the event is only a technical transfer with no governed information-model delivery claim.

required_evidence: project appointment, BEP, RACI or equivalent mapping for task team, lead appointed party and appointing party functions as applicable
Decision A or approval-for-sharing evidence for Work in Progress to Shared where applicable
task-team submission record for the information-model delivery sequence
lead-appointed-party review and authorization evidence where applicable
submission record for appointing-party acceptance where applicable
appointing-party acceptance or rejection evidence where applicable
information scope, purpose/status, permitted-use and applicable information-requirement references

result_logic.pass: The applicable ISO sequence, project function mapping, exchange declaration and transition evidence are complete and traceable, and supplementary TIVERIT or platform actions are not substituted for ISO activities.
result_logic.fail: A required ISO activity is omitted or replaced by coordination sign-off, milestone approval, issue closure, platform permission, technical publication or another non-equivalent action, or a project role is asserted as an ISO party function without a governing mapping.
result_logic.not_applicable: ISO 19650 is not applicable to the tested event or no governed information-model delivery is asserted.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable project appointment, role mapping, exchange declaration or decision evidence is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 conformance pass extends the exchange declaration test to detect missing Decision A/Decision B evidence, missing project role mapping, and substitution of supplementary TIVERIT/platform actions for ISO 19650 activities.
